subject: Request: retroactive merit + split payroll for EU engineer
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: anita.raju@acme.com, payrollops@payroll.example.com
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: retroactive merit + split payroll for EU engineer

Hi team,

Quick summary: Sofia Ivanova (IC, EU engineering) moved to our EU entity effective 2027-05-10. Her midcycle merit was approved on 2027-05-30, but payroll missed the June run because she was still in the onboarding queue during the payroll cutoff. She is eligible for the merit increase (effective 2027-05-30) and a one-time equity refresh slot approved by the committee.

Ask: Can we 1) apply the merit increase retroactively (salary adjustment backdated to 2027-05-30) and 2) split the approved one-time spot bonus into two payouts: 50% July payroll and 50% August payroll, to accommodate EU payroll cutoff and tax reporting?

Key constraints:
- Need finance sign-off on retro pay calculations and whether we can withhold taxes across two runs.
- HR needs the official approval memo and manager sign-off for equity refresh.
- External payroll team needs confirmation on cutoff windows (attached summary).

Attachments: [Attachment: payroll_cutoff_summary.pdf (pdf)] [Attachment: equity_refresh_proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]

Why this matters: Sofia is a strong contributor on the inference runtime team and the delay is starting to affect retention sentiment. I'd prefer a clean, compliant approach rather than an ad-hoc manual payment.

Next steps I propose:
- Logan: confirm whether retroactive payroll is OK and tax implications for a split payout.
- Mina: confirm HR approvals required and signoff process for equity refresh.
- Laura: if you can route to payroll contact for a firm cutoff date and any blocking documents.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Director, Engineering (Inference)
Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: logan.wright@redwood.ai, anita.raju@acme.com, payrollops@payroll.example.com
Date: 2027-06-19T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive merit + split payroll for EU engineer

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear summary. HR side: we have provisional committee approval on the equity refresh (see attached proposal) but need:
- Signed manager approval (Jonas) on the equity memo (I can attach the signature page).
- Confirmation that the retroactive salary change is recorded in the EU employment record with effective date 2027-05-30.

On split payouts: that's generally acceptable for spot bonuses in EU jurisdictions if payroll can process two gross payments and the local tax team confirms withholding is correct. We will need the employee's updated bank details and a signed consent form for split payments (small legal form). I can draft the consent and route for signature once Logan confirms the payroll mechanics.

I can own collecting signatures and uploading to the HR case.

Laura Bennett
Sr. People Partner
Redwood Inference
From: payrollops@payroll.example.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, logan.wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-20T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive merit + split payroll for EU engineer

Hi all,

Received — confirming payroll windows for EU entity:
- June cutoff was 2027-05-25 (missed for this case).
- Next regular runs: 2027-06-30 and 2027-07-31 (payments go out first business day of following month).

Options we can support:
1) Retroactive adjustment on the July 31 run for pay from 2027-05-30 through 2027-07-31 (single backpay entry). Standard approach, triggers gross-up taxes in the July period.
2) Split spot bonus: we can process 50% on July 31 and 50% on Aug 31, provided we receive a signed authorization and a completed payroll change form by 2027-06-24 for the July window.
3) Manual off-cycle payment: possible but requires separate approval and has higher fees; not preferred.

For tax treatment: local tax requires the full gross value to be declared in the month when paid. There's no legal barrier to splitting, but it changes withholding timing — please confirm whether the employee prefers split vs. single backpay so we can produce estimates.

Attachments: [Attachment: payroll_cutoff_summary.pdf]

Regards,
Payroll Ops (outsourced partner)
From: logan.wright@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, payrollops@payroll.example.com
Date: 2027-06-21T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive merit + split payroll for EU engineer

Team — thanks for the inputs. Finance decision: approve approach 2 (split the one-time spot bonus 50/50 across July and August) and process the merit as a retroactive salary adjustment recorded effective 2027-05-30 with backpay on the July 31 run. Conditions:

- Jonas: please confirm manager signoff on the equity refresh memo and send the signed manager approval by EOD 2027-06-22.
- Mina/Laura: please get the employee consent for split payout and upload the form to the HR case.
- Payroll Ops: please prepare gross/net estimates for both options and confirm any fees for processing split payouts; we accept the July/Aug schedule.

I will allocate the retroactive payroll budget to the EU headcount pool; no special exception to policy required, but please include the transaction in the monthly reconciliations.

Approved by,

Logan Wright
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
